title: Frontend Engineering & Browser Architecture
summary: Build production web interfaces while understanding the browser runtime, network, storage, accessibility and rendering model underneath React.

modules.title: HTML semantics, forms & document structure
modules.summary: Use the web platform correctly before adding framework abstractions.
modules.why: Semantic HTML improves accessibility, browser behaviour, resilience and maintainability.

units.title: Semantic document structure
units.summary: Represent meaning using the correct elements and document hierarchy.
units.challenge: Rebuild a div-heavy dashboard using semantic HTML only.
units.evidence: Accessibility tree/screenshots plus rationale for element choices.

units.title: Forms, inputs & native validation
units.summary: Use browser form semantics before implementing custom abstractions.
units.challenge: Build an accessible account form without a component library.
units.evidence: Keyboard-only demo and validation test cases.

units.title: Resilient markup & progressive enhancement
units.summary: Design interfaces that degrade gracefully and preserve core behaviour.
units.challenge: Make a critical workflow usable when JavaScript fails to load.
units.evidence: Failure-mode demo and trade-off note.

modules.title: CSS layout, responsive design & design systems
modules.summary: Master layout and visual architecture without fighting the cascade.
modules.why: Component frameworks do not remove the need to understand layout, inheritance, responsive behaviour and visual tokens.

units.title: Cascade, specificity & box model
units.summary: Predict how styles resolve and how element geometry is calculated.
units.challenge: Debug a deliberately conflicting stylesheet without using !important.
units.evidence: Annotated cascade decisions and fixed layout.

units.title: Flexbox, Grid & responsive layout
units.summary: Build layouts that adapt to content and viewport constraints.
units.challenge: Implement a dense admin UI across mobile/tablet/desktop without duplicate markup.
units.evidence: Responsive screenshots and explanation of layout breakpoints.

units.title: Design tokens & component styling architecture
units.summary: Create consistent visual primitives that scale across teams.
units.challenge: Create a small token-driven component system and add dark mode.
units.evidence: Token inventory plus component examples and change-propagation demo.

modules.title: JavaScript language fundamentals
modules.summary: Understand the language semantics that React and browser APIs build upon.
modules.why: Framework fluency without JavaScript fluency makes async bugs and state behaviour mysterious.

units.title: JavaScript values, objects & equality
units.summary: Understand dynamic values, references and object behaviour.
units.challenge: Implement data transformations while avoiding mutation/equality bugs.
units.evidence: Tests covering coercion, reference equality and mutation cases.

units.title: Scope, closures & modules
units.summary: Understand lexical scope and encapsulation in JavaScript.
units.challenge: Implement a small module with private state and explain closure lifetime.
units.evidence: Code plus memory/scope explanation.

units.title: Prototypes, classes & this
units.summary: Understand JavaScript's object model beneath class syntax.
units.challenge: Trace property lookup and this binding across tricky examples.
units.evidence: Prototype diagrams and tests.

modules.title: Asynchronous JavaScript & event loop
modules.summary: Reason precisely about tasks, promises, timers and browser concurrency.
modules.why: Race conditions and UI jank often come from misunderstanding scheduling rather than React itself.

units.title: Event loop, tasks & microtasks
units.summary: Predict execution order in the browser runtime.
units.challenge: Predict and then verify execution order for mixed timers/promises/events.
units.evidence: Timeline diagrams matched to runtime output.

units.title: Promises, async/await & failure propagation
units.summary: Compose async work without losing errors or cancellation state.
units.challenge: Build a multi-request workflow with cancellation and partial failure.
units.evidence: Failure matrix and implementation tests.

units.title: Race conditions & async coordination
units.summary: Prevent stale responses and concurrent UI state corruption.
units.challenge: Reproduce stale-search-results and double-submit bugs, then fix them.
units.evidence: Recorded reproduction and tests proving race mitigation.

modules.title: TypeScript for large applications
modules.summary: Use the type system to model domain and API contracts precisely.
modules.why: TypeScript pays off when types communicate constraints rather than merely annotate JavaScript.

units.title: Inference, unions & narrowing
units.summary: Model variants safely without falling back to any.
units.challenge: Model API success/error states as exhaustive discriminated unions.
units.evidence: Compiler-enforced exhaustive handling examples.

units.title: Generics, mapped & utility types
units.summary: Create reusable type-safe abstractions.
units.challenge: Design a typed form/config library API without unsafe casts.
units.evidence: Type-level examples showing valid/invalid usage.

units.title: Runtime boundaries & type safety limits
units.summary: Know where compile-time types end and runtime validation begins.
units.challenge: Validate untrusted API data before turning it into trusted domain types.
units.evidence: Boundary architecture showing parse/validate/trust stages.

modules.title: Browser rendering pipeline
modules.summary: Understand DOM/CSSOM, layout, paint and compositing so UI performance is explainable.
modules.why: Visual latency and jank are browser pipeline problems, not just component problems.

units.title: DOM, CSSOM & render tree
units.summary: Trace how source becomes renderable structures.
units.challenge: Use DevTools to identify render-blocking resources and DOM/CSSOM costs.
units.evidence: Annotated performance recording.

units.title: Layout, paint & compositing
units.summary: Distinguish geometry work from pixel painting and layer composition.
units.challenge: Create and fix a layout-thrashing animation.
units.evidence: Before/after frame timeline and explanation.

units.title: Main-thread scheduling & long tasks
units.summary: Protect interaction latency by managing main-thread work.
units.challenge: Move an expensive computation off the main thread and measure responsiveness.
units.evidence: Interaction-latency measurement before/after.

modules.title: Browser networking & HTTP caching
modules.summary: Understand resource loading, connection reuse and cache semantics from the client side.
modules.why: Frontend speed and correctness depend on protocol/cache decisions shared with backend and CDN layers.

units.title: Resource loading & network priority
units.summary: Understand discovery, priority and connection reuse.
units.challenge: Optimize a deliberately serial network waterfall.
units.evidence: Before/after waterfall with explanation of each change.

units.title: HTTP cache semantics in browsers
units.summary: Control freshness and validation without stale-content surprises.
units.challenge: Design caching policies for HTML, hashed assets and API responses.
units.evidence: Cache policy matrix with validation behaviour demonstrated.

units.title: Offline/poor-network resilience
units.summary: Design client behaviour under high latency, disconnects and retries.
units.challenge: Make a task edit flow survive temporary network loss and reconnection.
units.evidence: State machine showing pending/confirmed/conflicted states.

modules.title: Browser storage, workers & multi-tab state
modules.summary: Use browser persistence and cross-context communication safely.
modules.why: Sessions, offline features and multi-tab behaviour depend on storage scope and browser-process boundaries.

units.title: Cookies, localStorage & sessionStorage
units.summary: Choose storage based on security, lifecycle and scope.
units.challenge: Compare storing preferences, session identifiers and tokens across mechanisms.
units.evidence: Threat/behaviour matrix and demo.

units.title: IndexedDB & Cache Storage
units.summary: Persist structured/offline data without blocking the main thread.
units.challenge: Cache project metadata locally and handle schema upgrade.
units.evidence: Working offline read path plus upgrade test.

units.title: Service workers, BroadcastChannel & multi-tab coordination
units.summary: Coordinate tabs and background network behaviour deliberately.
units.challenge: Implement logout propagation and a single-tab background-refresh coordinator.
units.evidence: Multi-tab test plan and sequence diagrams.

modules.title: React mental model & component design
modules.summary: Understand rendering, state and effects before reaching for ecosystem abstractions.
modules.why: React code stays maintainable when components reflect data flow rather than lifecycle superstition.

units.title: Components, render & state
units.summary: Understand render as a pure calculation of UI from state/props.
units.challenge: Build a task board with predictable state transitions and no unnecessary effects.
units.evidence: Component tree and state ownership rationale.

units.title: Effects & synchronization
units.summary: Use effects only to synchronize with external systems.
units.challenge: Fix a component with redundant derived-state effects and stale async updates.
units.evidence: Before/after render/effect timeline.

units.title: Composition, context & reusable boundaries
units.summary: Build reusable UI APIs without giant global context or prop-drilling hacks.
units.challenge: Create reusable modal/form/list primitives used by multiple features.
units.evidence: Component API examples plus coupling analysis.

modules.title: Server state, client state, forms & routing
modules.summary: Separate different kinds of state and their consistency requirements.
modules.why: Most complex frontends fail from state ownership/conflict problems, not component syntax.

units.title: State taxonomy & ownership
units.summary: Distinguish server, URL, form, transient UI and persistent client state.
units.challenge: Classify every state value in a medium feature and eliminate duplicated sources of truth.
units.evidence: State map showing owner, lifetime and synchronization rule.

units.title: Data fetching, caching & optimistic updates
units.summary: Model remote data as cached asynchronous state.
units.challenge: Implement an optimistic task update with conflict/error rollback.
units.evidence: State transition diagram and failure tests.

units.title: Complex forms & routing architecture
units.summary: Treat forms and URL navigation as application state machines.
units.challenge: Build a multi-step editor resilient to refresh/back navigation.
units.evidence: Routing/form-state design and edge-case tests.

modules.title: Frontend architecture & rendering strategies
modules.summary: Design application boundaries, delivery modes and team ownership for large frontends.
modules.why: Frontend architecture becomes an organizational and operational problem at scale.

units.title: Feature boundaries & design-system architecture
units.summary: Organize code by product capability while sharing stable primitives.
units.challenge: Restructure a layer-based frontend into capability-oriented modules.
units.evidence: Dependency map before/after and ownership rules.

units.title: CSR, SSR, SSG & hydration
units.summary: Choose rendering strategy from UX, caching and operational requirements.
units.challenge: Design delivery strategies for admin SaaS, marketing site and news feed.
units.evidence: Decision matrix including latency, hosting, personalization and failure behaviour.

units.title: Micro-frontends & Backend-for-Frontend
units.summary: Understand when organizational decomposition justifies additional runtime boundaries.
units.challenge: Evaluate micro-frontends for a three-team SaaS product and propose a simpler alternative.
units.evidence: Architecture decision record with organizational constraints.

modules.title: Frontend performance engineering
modules.summary: Measure and improve loading, rendering and interaction performance.
modules.why: Performance is a product constraint with user and business impact.

units.title: Core Web Vitals & field/lab measurement
units.summary: Measure user-perceived loading and responsiveness correctly.
units.challenge: Capture baseline performance for a page and identify the dominant user-visible issue.
units.evidence: Performance budget and measurement report.

units.title: Bundles, code splitting & asset optimization
units.summary: Reduce bytes and critical-path work without cargo-cult lazy loading.
units.challenge: Reduce initial JS/asset cost while preserving navigation speed.
units.evidence: Bundle/waterfall before and after.

units.title: Rendering, virtualization & memory leaks
units.summary: Keep long-lived UIs responsive under large datasets and sessions.
units.challenge: Optimize a large scrolling list and find a seeded client memory leak.
units.evidence: Profiler recordings and retained-memory evidence.

modules.title: Accessibility engineering
modules.summary: Build inclusive interactions as a correctness requirement.
modules.why: Semantic, keyboard and assistive-technology support must survive real application complexity.

units.title: Keyboard interaction & focus management
units.summary: Make every interactive workflow usable without a pointer.
units.challenge: Make a modal/menu/table workflow keyboard-complete.
units.evidence: Keyboard test script and focus-state recording.

units.title: ARIA & screen-reader semantics
units.summary: Use ARIA to augment, not replace, native semantics.
units.challenge: Test a dynamic form with a screen reader and fix announcement/label issues.
units.evidence: Before/after accessibility tree and test notes.

units.title: Accessibility in design systems
units.summary: Bake accessible behaviour into shared primitives and review gates.
units.challenge: Define accessibility acceptance criteria for a component library.
units.evidence: Component checklist plus automated/manual test strategy.

modules.title: Frontend testing strategy
modules.summary: Test behaviour at component, browser and contract boundaries without brittle implementation coupling.
modules.why: Modern frontends need confidence across state, network and browser interaction layers.

units.title: Component & interaction tests
units.summary: Test visible behaviour rather than internal hook implementation.
units.challenge: Test a form/list feature through user-visible behaviour.
units.evidence: Tests that survive an internal refactor unchanged.

units.title: Browser end-to-end testing
units.summary: Validate critical journeys against a real browser and backend.
units.challenge: Automate login/project/task critical path with reliable selectors and diagnostics.
units.evidence: CI-ready E2E suite with trace artifact on failure.

units.title: Contract & visual-regression strategy
units.summary: Protect API assumptions and visual systems across independent teams.
units.challenge: Design a test portfolio for a frontend consumed by independently deployed APIs/design-system packages.
units.evidence: Test strategy showing what each layer catches and deliberately does not catch.
